title: Audit rubric calibration
description: Assess the same evidence blind across three auditors, then let a teacher model critique the auditors against the rubric until their grading agrees.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-qac-01
  title: Audit rubric calibration
  description: Assess the same evidence blind across three auditors, then let a teacher model critique
    the auditors against the rubric until their grading agrees.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce audit conclusions where grading consistency was demonstrated before findings are
    issued, and rubric ambiguity was repaired rather than argued about after the fact.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Control evidence package
      summary: Control evidence package
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - control_evidence
              - grading_rubric
              - scheme_clauses
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              control_evidence: {}
              grading_rubric: {}
              scheme_clauses: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-04
      name: First blind control assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Assessor testing readiness against a certification scheme before the real audit.
      prompt: You are a Certification Readiness Assessor. You test the organization against each clause
        of the scheme with the evidence that would be presented, and you grade readiness by clause rather
        than overall. You report a clause as not ready when the evidence exists but would not satisfy
        an auditor, because that distinction is the entire value of a readiness assessment.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - evidence-verification
          - operations-planning
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-06
      name: Second blind control assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Reviewer assessing whether the quality system works as documented.
      prompt: You are a Quality Management Reviewer. You test whether documented processes match what
        is actually done, whether records are contemporaneous and complete, and whether management review
        closes the loop on findings. You report a documented-but-unpracticed process as a finding, because
        the gap between the manual and the floor is where certification and reality separate.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-03
      name: Evidence sufficiency assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Collector assembling audit trails that stand up without the collector present.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Collector. You assemble evidence with its source system, extraction
        date, population basis, and completeness check attached, and you state when evidence is a sample
        rather than a population. You flag evidence that cannot be reproduced from the source system,
        because an audit trail that depends on someone remembering how it was made is not an audit trail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - statistical-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind audit panel
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once all member
        results are aggregated.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the calibration teacher for this audit panel. Critique the auditors against the
        grading rubric: where did two auditors grade the same evidence differently, where did an auditor
        accept evidence that would not satisfy an external assessor, and which rubric bands are too vague
        to grade consistently? Score the auditors, not the auditee.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-auditor agreement per clause and evidence sufficiency behind each grade.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-auditor agreement per clause and evidence sufficiency
        behind each grade. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Recalibrate until assessors agree
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Lead auditor approves the graded findings
      summary: Pause for the lead auditor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Audit rubric calibration deliverable, the evidence behind it, and
        every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-qac-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
